flags.title: Secondary sources disagree about the 2026 onside-kick rule's scope
flags.detail: The official operations.nfl.com 2026 rulebook table says Rule 6-1-6 'Permits the kicking team to declare an onside kick at any time during the game.' Two secondary articles found by web search claim the 2026 rule retains a trailing-team restriction, while others say any team may declare. This desk publishes only the official text and flags the conflict.

flags.title: Game Book copyright notice limits use without written NFL permission
flags.detail: The Game Book states the summary is for assisting media coverage; other use is prohibited without written permission. This desk publishes the minimal venue/lineup/inactive facts with attribution and a link to the official PDF, mirroring the scope the Game Book desk already established; no play-by-play is republished.

flags.title: One unlabelled record cell in the rendered standings rows is not published
flags.detail: Each standings row renders an extra record cell between the conference-percentage and streak cells (e.g. BAL '2 - 1 - 0'); the text layer prints no label for it, so this desk neither publishes nor interprets that cell.

flags.title: The frozen 149-final results corpus is not edited by this desk
flags.detail: The corpus in nfl-results/data/games-2026-w1-10.csv (owned by another session) holds 149 finals with LAC@BAL scheduled-not-final. This desk records the 150th final read-only; the feed reaches 150 only across the two desks' files.
